posts.text: I am pleased to nominate Jim O’Neill to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Middle District of North Carolina. Jim has the strong support of both North Carolina Senators, Ted Budd and Thom Tillis. Jim has served as the District Attorney of Forsyth County since 2009, and has been a prosecutor in that office since 1997. He has a deep track record of being tough on crime, and preserving Law and Order. Jim is a graduate of Duke University (where he played varsity lacrosse), and New York Law School. posts.text: I am proud to announce that the FIFA Women's World Cup 2031 will take place in the United States! After hosting the Most Successful World Cup in History, no Country is better positioned than the United States to be home to the largest Women's Sporting Event in History. The FIFA Women's World Cup 2031 will bring Generational Economic Impact to the United States, grow the sport of Soccer throughout our Country and the World, and showcase America’s Exceptionalism. Thank you to Gianni Infantino, and his great staff, for working to bring the Tournament to the U.S.A. President DONALD J. TRUMP
